definitionZh: 填充规则CSS属性定义了用于确定SVG形状画布中哪些部分包含在待填充的形状内的规则. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The fill-rule CSS property defines the rule used to determine which parts of the SVG shape's canvas are included inside a shape to be filled. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
